answer: Each agent deposits a non-transferable bond of locked POA that unlocks only after four consecutive epochs of uniquely attested work. Creating a Sybil clone forces the attacker to post an identical bond and wait the full ridge of unlock epochs. A pearl-linked joint slash burns the entire farm bond if any clone fails a random hardware uniqueness check. The linear timber-scale capital lock plus multi-epoch delay makes large-scale fabrication cost more than the expected reward from honest single-identity participation.
